donepezil_flow.source: Watanabe et al., Clinics (Sao Paulo) 2026, PMC13573712, Results: Loss to follow-up
donepezil_flow.quote: After the start of treatment, 14 individuals (40%) in the active drug group dropped out, 13 due to side effects (93%) and 1 (7%) due to change of address. In the placebo group, 9 individuals (25.7%) were excluded: 5 due to side effects (55.6%), 3 (33%) due to irregular use of medication, and 1 (11%) due to personal reasons (recovery from orthopedic surgery). It was observed that among the reasons for dropout, adverse effects were predominantly higher in the donepezil group compared to the placebo group (p = 0.006)

donepezil_allocation.quote: Of the total of 70 patients selected (35 in the donepezil group and 35 in the placebo group), 47 patients (67.1%) completed the treatment
